facts.text: Ot2Driver keeps the robot address, the port (default 31950), the current run id, the base URL and the header Opentrons-Version: 2
ping sends GET /health and raises unless the status code is 200
upload_and_schedule_protocol posts the file as protocol.py to /protocols, then posts a run of that protocol to /runs and keeps its id as run_id
start_run posts the run action play to /runs/<id>/actions
pause_protocol and resume_protocol post the run actions pause and play for the current run
cancel_protocol posts the run action stop, then deletes the run, only logging a failed delete, and forgets the run id
get_run_status gets /runs/<id> with a 30 s timeout and returns the JSON body
wait_for_completion reads data.status every 2 s: succeeded ends it, and stopped, failed or blocked-by-open-door raise
close cancels an active run and only logs an error
No requests call of Ot2Driver other than get_run_status passes a timeout
ABCToolDriver answers any attribute it does not define with a function that returns None
The OT-2 tool server's configure step leaves the Ot2Driver construction commented out, so its commands reach the ToolServer's ABCToolDriver
The tool server's RunProgram writes the script with injected variables to a temporary file and runs it with start_protocol
The pack's example OT-2 protocol loads a p300 single-channel pipette, picks up a tip and drops it

measures.description: The id of the last run this endpoint created; empty before the first run
measures.name: run_id

measures.description: The robot server's status of that run (data.status, driver.py:223); empty without a run
measures.name: run_status

operator_required.name: run_protocol
operator_required.reason: a protocol file runs arbitrary pipetting on the OT-2; the operator's site limits list the exact files (absolute paths on the driver host) a model may upload and run

safe_state.description: no protocol run of this endpoint executing: the e-stop sends the run action stop and reads the run's status until it is succeeded, stopped or failed (driver.py:175-181, 199-231); the robot's gantry, tips and liquids stay where the run left them
